_notes: Deterministic retrieval bench corpus (doc 17 par.4). Every entry carries a fixed memory_id (uuid5 of the key) and a declared created_at, so ids and dates are identical on every darkmem_bench reseed. Seed via benchlib.retrieval_gold.seed_memory_rows, then run_ingest. Authoring rules and slice design live in SLICES.md; temporal-group contents must stay calendar-date-free and update pairs must stay inside the 90-day supersession window.

memories.content: Grafana on the monitoring host listens on port 3000 behind the nginx reverse proxy.
Prometheus scrapes the node exporters every 15 seconds, double the default interval.
The staging Postgres runs version 15.6 on host stg-db-01.
Nightly restic backups of the wiki volume run at 02:30 and land on the NAS.
The CI runners use Docker-in-Docker and are capped at four concurrent jobs.
We chose Caddy over nginx for the public reverse proxy because it renews certificates automatically.
Build artifacts are stored in the MinIO bucket named artifacts-prod.
Redis on cache-01 runs with maxmemory 2gb and the allkeys-lru eviction policy.
The VPN is WireGuard on UDP port 51820, handing peers addresses in 10.8.0.0/24.
Loki keeps logs for 30 days; the compactor deletes older chunks.
The mail relay is Postfix on mail-01, accepting connections only from the internal subnet.
The Kubernetes workers run k3s v1.29.4 on three Odroid boards.
The status dashboard frontend is built with Vite and shipped as static files.
Terraform state lives in the MinIO bucket tf-state with locking enabled.
Alert notifications route through ntfy; critical pages also go out as SMS.
Internal DNS is Unbound at 192.168.20.53 with a wildcard zone for lab.internal.
The nightly integration suite starts at 03:15 and uploads a JUnit report to the artifacts bucket.
Feature flags are served by a self-hosted Unleash instance; its admin UI sits behind OIDC login.
Kibana listened on port 5601 before the ELK stack was retired.
The production Postgres runs version 16.2 on host prod-db-01.
Every host runs a node exporter listening on port 9100.
Weekly full backups of the photo library run on Sundays at 04:00 to the offsite box.
Internal-only tools sit behind an nginx proxy that requires client certificates.
Redis on queue-01 backs the job queue with AOF persistence enabled.
Grafana dashboards for the storage pool live in the infra folder.
The guest Wi-Fi VLAN is isolated and cannot reach the 10.8.0.0/24 VPN range.
The billing-sync service is deployed on host apps-02.
Host apps-02 is on the rack UPS that failed its most recent self-test.
The image-resize worker consumes jobs from the thumbs queue on queue-01.
The thumbs queue on queue-01 develops latency spikes under memory pressure.
The team wiki runs on the shared virtual machine lab-vm-3.
lab-vm-3 is scheduled for decommissioning once the new hypervisor arrives.
The analytics ETL depends on the nightly dump of the orders database.
The nightly dump of the orders database is skipped whenever the replication-lag alarm is active.
Storefront releases go through the blue-green switcher on the edge router.
The blue-green switcher drops open websocket sessions whenever it flips.
The chat-ops bot authenticates to the API gateway with the svc-bot token.
The svc-bot token expires every 90 days and is rotated by hand.
Search on the docs site is served by the Typesense instance on search-01.
search-01 has no swap configured and kills its largest process under memory pressure.
The license-report job pulls dependency data from the internal package mirror.
The internal package mirror throttles any client that exceeds 100 requests per minute.
Customer-portal session tokens are signed with a key kept in the vault namespace apps/portal.
The vault namespace apps/portal seals itself automatically when the audit-log volume fills up.
Alice is the on-call engineer this month; escalations go to her first.
Bob has taken over on-call this month; escalations go to him first.
Dana is the on-call engineer this month; escalations go to her first.
The storage pool is at 62% capacity.
The storage pool has climbed to 71% capacity.
The storage pool sits at 83% capacity after the video imports.
The platform team currently has four engineers.
The platform team has grown to six engineers.
The wildcard certificate was renewed and is valid for the next 90 days.
The wildcard certificate has been renewed for another 90-day period.
This sprint's focus is the payments refactor.
This sprint's focus is observability cleanup.
This quarter's goal is cutting infrastructure spend by 15 percent.
This quarter's goal is shipping the mobile beta.
Portal session storage uses Memcached on cache-02.
Portal session storage moved from Memcached to Redis on cache-02; Memcached is retired.
Deploys are triggered by the Jenkins pipeline on ci-01.
The deploy pipeline moved from Jenkins to GitHub Actions; ci-01 is being wound down.
Application errors are tracked in the self-hosted Sentry instance.
Error tracking moved from self-hosted Sentry to GlitchTip; the old instance is read-only.
The docs site is generated with MkDocs on every push to main.
The docs site now builds with Astro instead of MkDocs; the MkDocs config was deleted.
Containers read their secrets from per-host .env files.
Container secrets now come from Vault; the per-host .env files were removed.
Internal metrics are collected by Telegraf into InfluxDB.
We are considering moving metrics collection from Telegraf to Vector, pending a bake-off.
The issue tracker is a self-hosted Gitea instance.
We might switch the issue tracker to Forgejo next quarter if the migration tooling matures.
The invoice-pdf renderer runs on host hv-27.
hv-27 keeps filling its scratch partition because the cleanup cron job was disabled.
The team-calendar sync job signs in through the ops-oauth app registration.
The ops-oauth app registration has admin consent only in the primary directory tenant, not the guest tenant.
The door-badge system validates cards against the directory replica on acs-01.
acs-01 runs several minutes behind because NTP is filtered on its management subnet.
The monthly payroll export is delivered through the transfer host sftp-02.
The DNS record for sftp-02 keeps a day-long TTL and goes stale whenever the host fails over.
The meeting-room displays pull their booking schedule from the fleet-cfg repository.
The fleet-cfg repository exceeds its storage quota whenever marketing checks in large binary assets.
The rooftop weather station reports its readings through the iot-gw-1 gateway.
iot-gw-1 runs a nightly firmware check that reboots it whether or not an update was applied.
Receipt scans from the expense tool are processed by the OCR worker on gpu-01.
gpu-01 falls back to software-only processing when its accelerator driver loses the device.
Internal podcast episodes are served from the MinIO bucket arc-store.
A lifecycle rule on the arc-store bucket strips public-read access from objects after a short grace period.
The mobile app downloads its translation bundles from edge-cdn-4.
edge-cdn-4 presents an expired TLS certificate to devices that validate strictly.
Timesheet reminders are sent out by the hook-runner service.
The hook-runner service keeps its outbound spool on a volume that gets remounted read-only during backups.
The office label printers get their jobs from the lp-relay service.
The lp-relay service restarts every time the config management agent runs.
Authelia runs on auth-01 and listens on port 9091 for its web portal.
auth-02 is a hot standby for auth-01, and Authelia on auth-02 depends on the session store on kv-01.
Consul runs on core-03 and monitors the health checks for jobs-05.
Concourse is deployed on build-04 and uses Garage on files-01 to store its build artifacts.
Garage on files-01 stores build artifacts in the forge-artifacts bucket, and backs up that bucket nightly to batch-01.
ClickHouse runs on data-06 and depends on the nightly export from ledger-02.
Airflow runs on etl-02 and depends on ClickHouse on data-06 as its warehouse sink.
Memgraph runs on graph-01 and stores the dependency graph for the meridian project.
Huginn runs on hooks-03 and depends on Consul on core-03 for service discovery.
The anvil-render pipeline has ImageMagick on images-02 as a part, and it depends on the fonts stored on files-01.
Celery runs on jobs-05 and depends on the message broker on core-03.
Infisical runs on keys-01 and stores the signing keys used by Authelia.
CockroachDB runs on ledger-02 and replaced Firebird, the database ledger-02 used before the migration.
FFmpeg runs on media-04 and depends on the codec pack maintained on files-01.
Luigi runs on batch-01 and monitors the completion status of Airflow tasks on etl-02.
Graylog runs on log-02 and stores ingest logs from every host in the meridian project.
HAProxy runs on lb-01 and listens on port 8443 for the meridian project's public API.
Meilisearch runs on idx-03 and depends on the document feed produced by Huginn on hooks-03.
Ansible is deployed on infra-02 and depends on the inventory stored on files-01.
jump-01 is a bastion host and monitors failed SSH attempts against auth-01.
Icinga runs on mon-05 and monitors HAProxy on lb-01.
etcd runs on kv-01 and stores the leader-election state for Consul on core-03.
Concourse on build-04 listens on port 8080 for its web UI, and depends on Garage on files-01 for its artifact cache.
The forge-artifacts bucket on files-01 has object versioning as a part of its configuration, and Garage stores those versions for 90 days before they expire.
auth-01 depends on etcd on kv-01 for distributed locks during token rotation, and Authelia causes a brief login outage whenever etcd on kv-01 restarts.
Consul on core-03 causes elevated latency on idx-03 whenever it re-elects its leader, and Consul also monitors Memgraph on graph-01.
batch-01 is a cold-storage host and backs up the ledger-02 database nightly.
media-04 depends on jobs-05 to queue transcoding requests through Celery, and FFmpeg on media-04 stores rendered output on files-01.
graph-01 is deployed behind lb-01, and HAProxy listens on port 7474 for Memgraph's browser console.
log-02 monitors Concourse build failures on build-04 and stores them under a dedicated index in Graylog.
images-02 depends on the anvil-render pipeline's font cache on files-01, and ImageMagick causes memory spikes when rendering large batches.
keys-01 has Infisical as a part, and Infisical replaced the plaintext .env files that auth-01 used before the migration.
etl-02 stores raw ingest files on files-01, and Airflow depends on that staging area before loading ClickHouse on data-06.
jump-01 depends on Authelia on auth-01 for multi-factor login before granting SSH access, and it monitors every session for the meridian project's audit log.
mon-05 causes alert storms on lb-01 whenever Icinga's check interval drops below one minute, and Icinga on mon-05 also monitors etcd on kv-01.
core-03 is a service-mesh host and has Consul as a part of its control plane.
data-06 backs up ClickHouse to Garage on files-01 every six hours, and the backup depends on a healthy etcd lock on kv-01.
idx-03 replaced idx-01, the earlier Meilisearch host retired after a disk failure, and Meilisearch on idx-03 listens on port 7700.
ledger-02 monitors CockroachDB's replication lag and causes a paging alert on mon-05 when the lag exceeds five minutes.
files-01 has Garage as a part of its storage stack, and Garage depends on the disk array mounted on batch-01.
auth-02 listens on port 9091 as a passive replica, and it backs up Authelia's configuration from auth-01 every hour.
The meridian project depends on core-03 for service discovery, and Consul on core-03 monitors Authelia on auth-01.
The notify-relay service is deployed on host neon-04 and listens on port 8825.
neon-04 depends on the NATS message bus for internal event delivery.
The order-sync service runs on host nimbus-02 and uses RabbitMQ as its task queue.
nimbus-02 stores its working data in the nimbus-archive object bucket.
Netdata monitors every host in the fulfillment fleet, including orbit-01 and onyx-03.
orbit-01 runs OpenSearch as the backing store for the internal log index.
OpenTelemetry traces from orbit-01 are exported to the collector on onyx-03.
onyx-03 is a dedicated trace-collection host with no other workloads.
The parcel-tracker service depends on the parcel-logs bucket for historical lookups.
parcel-tracker is deployed on host pallet-02 and listens on port 9040.
pallet-02 backs up its state nightly to the parcel-logs bucket.
Osquery runs on pivot-01 and reports fleet inventory to the quota-watcher service.
quota-watcher uses PowerDNS to resolve internal service names before rate-checking them.
PowerDNS runs on quire-03 and serves the zone yard.lab for the fulfillment network.
quire-03 depends on the QEMU hypervisor cluster for its virtual machines.
Pi-hole runs on ridge-01 and blocks ad traffic for the guest network.
ridge-01 uses quire-03 as its upstream DNS resolver.
Rclone runs on slate-03 and mirrors the slate-media volume to the nimbus-archive bucket nightly.
Syncthing runs on spire-01 and keeps the design archive synced with vane-01.
talon-01 backs up its database nightly to the talon-backups bucket.
talon-01 is the primary metadata store for the fulfillment application.
Woodpecker CI runs on tether-02 and builds every push to the fulfillment monorepo.
tether-02 sits behind Traefik, which terminates TLS for the internal build UI.
Woodpecker pushes finished container images to the Quay registry after each successful build on tether-02.
The roster-sync service is deployed on tether-02 and listens on port 8600.
Wazuh runs on umbra-04 and monitors host integrity across the fulfillment fleet.
Teleport runs on warden-02 and brokers SSH access to every production host, including talon-01.
warden-02 uses Tailscale to reach hosts on the warehouse VLAN without a VPN concentrator.
warden-02 stores every access grant in the warden-audit dataset.
Zulip runs on vane-01 and notifies the ticket-router service of new support threads.
The ticket-router service is deployed on wisp-01 and depends on Zulip for incoming support requests.
wisp-01 listens on port 9500 for the ticket-router's internal API.
xenon-02 has a ZFS pool as its primary storage and scrubs it every Sunday.
xenon-02 backs up its ZFS pool nightly to the xenon-snapshots bucket.
Slurm runs on yarrow-01 and depends on zephyr-03 for shared scratch storage during batch renders.
zephyr-03 is a dedicated scratch-storage host with no user-facing services.
Uptime Kuma monitors the notify-relay and order-sync endpoints, paging quota-watcher on failure.
Rundeck replaced the patch-runner cron scripts for scheduled maintenance across the fleet.
vane-01 runs Samba to share the design archive with the warehouse floor terminals.
pgAdmin runs on quire-03 and has read-only access to the fulfillment reporting database.
Osquery's inventory sweep on pivot-01 causes brief CPU spikes on quota-watcher during the nightly report.
RabbitMQ on nimbus-02 has the order-events queue as a part of the order-sync pipeline.
